name: dsh-prompt-studio
author: Hana Amelia
description: GUI preset authoring entry: a sidebar 「预设」 panel lists every agent preset, edits its system prompt (persona prefix/suffix) and display metadata in place, and creates new presets from a base template. Saves go into the profile patch (comment-preserving YAML), the live reload re-registers the preset for new sessions.

scripts.test: node --check presets.js && node --check client.js && node --test test/presets.test.mjs
